title: Pair request
description: POST /v1/pair (D6). The secret comes from the QR code or the manual code the Hub's admin screen shows; it is good once, for five minutes. Closed input.

secret.description: The 128-bit pairing secret as lowercase hex.

platform.description: The device/platform values that pair: windows_hub is only the Hub's own Device row.

device_name.description: Shown in the Hub's device list. No control characters.
